Mine in Basibasy, Atsimo-Andrefana, Madagascar Basibasy mine Basibasy mine Location Location Basibasy Atsimo-Andrefana Country Madagascar Coordinates 22°9′S 43°36′E ﻿ / ﻿ 22.150°S 43.600°E ﻿ / -22.150; 43.600 Production Products Titanium The Basibasy mine is one of the largest titanium mines in Madagascar . [ 1 ] The mine is located in Basibasy , Atsimo-Andrefana . [ 1 ] The mine has reserves amounting to 446 million tonnes of ore grading 5.5% titanium .
